author: Tgolfz
quote: The best game I have ever played, despite being only 5 hours in. Was originally BOTW for me but this tops it and just felt fresh and new despite being a remaster. Controls are extremely satisfying and game runs buttery smooth on switch 2 and is just a great game to immerse yourself in.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Tgolfz
quote: Horrible performance on my launch PS5, felt like we went back in time despite updated graphics. Slow pacing and story that felt recycled from every GTA and didn’t have me on the edge of my seat.
